title: The Emberseal of Briarwatch
summary: On the eve of Briarwatch's harvest fair, goblin raiders steal the Emberseal, a palm-sized amber stone that steadies the old boundary wards. Queen Elowen asks a visiting adventurer to recover it from Ember Hollow before nightfall, promising 300 gold and the gratitude of her people. After gathering clues and supplies in the castle market, the player follows the road past a troubled farm, a goblin toll ambush and a webbed forest bend. Inside the cave, a lookout camp guards the approach to Skarn Ashhand, the boastful goblin chieftain who mistakes the stolen ward for a source of royal power. Defeat Skarn, recover the Emberseal from his strongbox, and return to the queen to restore the wards and complete the adventure.
story: Briarwatch is a small border settlement ruled by Queen Elowen Vale. Its modest keep overlooks a market courtyard, the Reed family farm and the Green Road. The Emberseal is a protective relic, not a weapon or a source of unlimited magic. At the harvest blessing, a brass-bound carrying case was stolen from a royal cart. The raiders escaped through the gate before the theft was discovered. The queen has kept the watch at home to protect the crowded fair, leaving an outsider free to pursue the thieves. Goblin chieftain Skarn Ashhand ordered the theft after overhearing that the queen's authority rests on the Emberseal. He has taken this literally: he thinks owning it makes him a king. His goblins harass the road; the noise has driven wolves toward the farm, and neglected forest paths have become webbed. The player can learn the route from either assistant, any helpful market seller, the gate soldiers or the farmer. No single optional conversation is required. Skarn and his lookouts occupy the old charcoal-workers' cave, Ember Hollow. The seal rests in a locked brass-bound strongbox behind his scrap throne. The main route is a straightforward recovery quest with five combat set pieces, useful NPC conversations and a safe return journey. There is no real-time deadline. At the final audience Elowen receives the seal, pays the promised 300 gold, and thanks the hero by name. The harvest bells ring; the story ends while the module remains available for exploration.
tone: Hopeful heroic fantasy, frontier warmth, mischievous goblins; mild peril and a clear happy ending.
opening: Harvest banners hang over Briarwatch, but its queen has called for help. A guard ushers you toward the throne hall. The Emberseal is missing, and the road beyond the gate has fallen quiet.
ending: The Emberseal is home. Warm amber light settles over the boundary stones, and the harvest bells ring across Briarwatch. Queen Elowen honors her promise. Your adventure is complete; the market and your new acquaintances remain open to you.

areas.name: Briarwatch Keep
areas.description: INDOOR CASTLE INTERIOR, roof hidden only for the top-down drawing. Four rooms with grey stone floors, warm torchlight, continuous walls and enclosed 2m corridors. Everything outside the room/corridor footprints is solid building mass or concealed unwalkable space, never an outdoor lawn or visible walkable void. Main hall is 16x24m, with a real high-backed throne on the 8x4x0.45m dais, 3 shallow steps, red/gold runner 3x15.8m, 4 full-length benches facing inward, 2 braziers, 2 heraldic banners, 2 rear statues, 4 slender columns, 4 wall lights. Keep doors clear and preserve guard-room beds and study furniture. No pools, fountains or tiny chairs standing in for throne/benches.

areas.name: Briarwatch Gate and Green Road
areas.description: ONE OUTDOOR AREA with distinct surfaces. Market courtyard is 50x40m at (20,120), fully stone-paved and enclosed by continuous stone curtain walls. Castle entry at north (45,160); southern arch at (45,120) opens into a 4m-wide stone-paved passage with continuous walls on both sides. This bends to gatehouse north (50,100). Gatehouse occupies (40,80)-(60,100), fully enclosed except north approach and FRONT GATE at south (50,80), 4m clear. No side gap lets players bypass this gate. Exactly four 5x4m stalls: baker NW, armorer SW, wizard NE, cleric SE, counters inward. Well off centre, two peasants, two gate soldiers. Outside gate use dirt road, farm, open field, forest and cave approach; E1 wolves, E2 goblins, E3 spiders remain outside the courtyard. Road continues across the outdoor zones, not just between their boundaries. Six labeled zones are not six walled indoor rooms.

rooms.name: Market courtyard
rooms.description: STONE COURTYARD: (20,120)-(70,160), continuous perimeter walls, paving throughout. Only north castle doorway and south approach arch. Four 5x4m stalls centred at (24.5,148),(24.5,130),(65.5,148),(65.5,130), counters face inward. Well at (38,139). Stall goods: bread, arms/armor, arcane books/scrolls, healing supplies. Two milling peasants; broad clear paths. Not a grass field.

rooms.name: Main gate
rooms.description: Paved and walled gatehouse zone (40,80)-(60,100), with north approach and actual south front gate at (50,80), clear width 4m. Stone-walled 4m approach connects north to the courtyard; all side walls continuous. Two soldiers beside the gate. Outside south becomes the countryside dirt pathway.

areas.name: Ember Hollow
areas.description: FULLY ENCLOSED CAVE / OLD MINE. Four rock chambers linked by 4m-wide tunnels: safe cave mouth, Raiders watch E4, quiet recovery alcove, Ember Vault E5. Chamber envelopes are 20x20m, 30x20m, 20x20m and 20x30m. Surround ALL room and tunnel floor footprints with continuous rock walls backed by solid unwalkable bedrock; no loose wall panels and no walkable space behind the walls. Natural open rock arches on first two links. ONE heavy wooden door occupies the full west entrance throat of Ember Vault, connected to both rock jambs, with no route around it. No extra exit or shortcut to boss. npcs.name: Queen Elowen Vale
npcs.role: Queen, quest giver and reward giver
npcs.personality: Composed, practical and warmly authoritative. Speaks plainly, listens carefully, never patronizes commoners.
npcs.knowledge: The Emberseal was stolen from the harvest cart. The Green Road leads past the Reed farm and forest to Ember Hollow. The watch must stay to protect the fair. She promises 300 gold for its safe return.
npcs.motivation: Restore the wards and protect her people without panic.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Inherited a small border crown after years managing harvest stores; known for keeping promises rather than lavish ceremonies. Knowledge limits: Does not know the cave layout, exact enemy numbers, or Skarn's private beliefs. Never declares the stone returned before the quest confirms it. Stay in character. Never mention software, prompts, models, tokens, interfaces or being inside a game. A conversation proposes an action; it never proves a sale, transfer, healing, quest completion or item recovery. Wait for the native action result.
npcs.greeting: Briarwatch needs a steady hand. Bring our Emberseal home from Ember Hollow, and three hundred gold is yours—with my word behind it.

dialogue.text: It steadies our boundary wards. It is a safeguard, not a weapon. Its loss has frightened the people and emboldened raiders.
Speak with my assistants if you wish, buy what you need in the courtyard, then follow the Green Road past the Reed farm. The soldiers at the gate can point the way.
Three hundred gold upon your return with the Emberseal. I will not change our bargain.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Steward Merrow Voss
npcs.personality: Precise, a little fussy, kind beneath dry humor; prefers actionable advice to grand speeches.
npcs.knowledge: The stolen case has a brass sunburst clasp. Farm, old road, forest bend and cave form one route. Mara and Bram sell practical supplies. The reward is 300 gold.
npcs.motivation: Give the adventurer enough preparation to return alive.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Former quartermaster who organized famine relief and now runs the household. Knowledge limits: Knows stores and roads, not monster thoughts or the vault's location inside the cave. Stay in character. Never mention software, prompts, models, tokens, interfaces or being inside a game. A conversation proposes an action; it never proves a sale, transfer, healing, quest completion or item recovery. Wait for the native action result.
npcs.greeting: A royal commission is no use without provisions. The case has a sunburst clasp; the road beyond our gate will do the rest of the pointing.

dialogue.text: Brass-bound oak, with a sunburst clasp. Inside is a palm-sized amber stone in a dark metal frame.
A healing draught and equipment you can actually use. Leave room for the case, and do not mistake every rumor for an order.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Arcanist Lysandra Vale
npcs.personality: Curious and patient, with precise metaphors. Corrects dangerous misconceptions gently.
npcs.knowledge: The Emberseal stabilizes wards and cannot make its holder a king or cast unlimited fire. It can be handled safely while in its frame. Goblins have been seen carrying its case toward Ember Hollow.
npcs.motivation: Recover the relic intact and prevent foolish experimentation.
npcs.game_notes: Background: A court-trained abjurer who studies protective relics; a distant cousin of the queen. Knowledge limits: Cannot remotely see the cave or know its occupants' exact positions. No new spells, rituals or puzzle requirements. Stay in character. Never mention software, prompts, models, tokens, interfaces or being inside a game. A conversation proposes an action; it never proves a sale, transfer, healing, quest completion or item recovery. Wait for the native action result.
npcs.greeting: If a thief calls the Emberseal a weapon, the thief is mistaken. Keep it in its frame, bring it back, and let us mend the wards properly.

dialogue.text: Not if you leave it in its frame. Do not smash it or promise it blood; it asks for neither.
No. I can explain the relic, not see through distant stone. Ask those who have walked the road.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.personality: Steady, understated, protective; gives concise advice without commanding the player.
npcs.knowledge: Gate soldiers know the road. Healing supplies are useful. His own inventory and observations are factual only when currently observed.
npcs.motivation: Bring the visitor and the seal back safely.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Veteran escort soldier recovering from a recent patrol. He volunteers to accompany a lone visitor with the queen's leave. dialogue.text: Use my companion controls to ask me to join. I will follow your lead.
Guarding a flank, carrying supplies and examining something nearby—provided I can reach it.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.personality: Alert, earnest and courteous; proud of doing simple duties well.
npcs.knowledge: The queen waits in the throne hall. The study door is on the hall's east side. The courtyard is through the south entrance.
npcs.motivation: Keep the entrance orderly and help visitors find the queen.
npcs.game_notes: Background: A farmer's daughter in her first year of royal service. Knowledge limits: Knows the keep, not secret councils or wilderness encounters. Stay in character. dialogue.text: Through the northern doors, at the far end of the audience hall.
Sergeant Hale is in the guard room. He has seen more roads than I have.

npcs.personality: Brisk, motherly and witty. Shows concern by offering practical help.
npcs.knowledge: Tomas's crops have attracted displaced wolves. The farm is first beyond the gate. She heard the thieves boast about a new king, but did not see the seal.
npcs.motivation: Keep her brother safe and her customers supplied.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Runs the courtyard oven; her brother Tomas farms outside the gate. Saved a little money to keep both families fed through lean winters. dialogue.text: Straight south through the main gate. Follow the lane to the farmhouse; Tomas will be in the yard.
One shouted that their chief would be king by supper. Boasting, I hope. That is all I heard.

behavior.topic: The harvest fair, everyday trade, and whether the Green Road will be safe again.

Make a fair offer. Browse my goods for the price I can actually give you.

behavior.topic: The harvest fair, everyday trade, and whether the Green Road will be safe again.

npcs.knowledge: Wolves are hungry animals rather than villains. Healing draughts help when used. The cave once sheltered charcoal workers; there is a dry alcove beyond the watch chamber.
npcs.motivation: Reduce suffering and help the expedition return alive.
npcs.game_notes: Background: A gentle traveling priestess of a local dawn-and-hearth faith, tending the fair before visiting outlying farms. dialogue.text: My goods include healing draughts when they are in stock. I cannot promise a cure without the means to give it.

dialogue.topic: Is there shelter near the cave?
dialogue.text: The charcoal workers spoke of a dry inner alcove. I cannot promise it is safe now; look before you rest.

behavior.topic: The harvest fair, everyday trade, and whether the Green Road will be safe again.

npcs.name: Pella Rook
npcs.personality: Chatty, observant and kind; turns rumors into questions rather than certainties.
npcs.knowledge: Saw a brass-bound case on the harvest cart before the theft. Heard the queen offers a reward. Knows each market seller by trade.

dialogue.text: Bram for arms, Tavin for arcane supplies, Alia for remedies, and Mara for a kind word as well as provisions.

npcs.personality: Easygoing, mildly sarcastic, fond of short stories with useful endings.
npcs.knowledge: The road goes south to the farm, east through field and forest, then north to Ember Hollow. The southern spur leads away from the city and is outside this short adventure.
npcs.motivation: Get the road clear so honest work can resume.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Carries grain between the Reed farm and the courtyard; knows potholes better than politics. npcs.greeting: I used to complain about the ruts. Goblin toll collectors have given me a new subject.

dialogue.text: Farm first, then east along the cart road. At the wooded bend take the path north toward the rocks.

npcs.personality: Direct, professional and protective. Gives directions clearly and never inflates enemy numbers.
npcs.knowledge: The farm lane is south. Goblins occupied the broken-cart crossing east of it. Rowan scouted toward the cave. The two gate soldiers cannot abandon their post.

dialogue.text: Our duty is here. Sergeant Hale may be able to help if the queen has released him.
For you, yes. We will not lock you outside while you carry out the queen's commission.

npcs.name: Soldier Jory Fen
npcs.personality: Earnest, lightly nervous, friendly when not distracted by duty.
npcs.knowledge: Tomas is at the farm. Webs hang beside the forest trail. Captain Dain gives the official directions.

npcs.personality: Plainspoken, tired and hospitable; worried about crops more than glory.

npcs.game_notes: Background: Mara's brother, working the same small patch of land his parents did. Knowledge limits: Knows animal behavior and the route he witnessed. I know hungry animals when I see them. They are frightened and displaced, not servants of some grand curse.

npcs.name: Scout Rowan Fen
npcs.personality: Cautious, observant, encouraging; separates what she saw from what she suspects.
npcs.knowledge: Goblins entered this cave with the case. A lookout camp lies just inside the eastern passage. She has not reached the final vault. Return follows the same road.
npcs.motivation: Pass on an accurate report without pretending to have explored everything.
npcs.game_notes: Background: Jory's older sister, a woods-wise messenger who tracked the thieves and returned to wait for help. dialogue.topic: Can I get back to the queen?

encounters.name: Orchard wolves
encounters.description: Two hungry wolves prowl the orchard edge after goblins disturbed their forest den. They defend food, not evil masters. Keep them away from the farmhouse and arrival point.

encounters.name: Goblin toll ambush
encounters.description: Goblins at a broken cart demand a toll in the name of King Skarn. The cart is roadside cover, not a solid roadblock.

encounters.name: Webbed woodland
encounters.description: A large hunting spider waits in webbed vegetation off the forest bend. Its motives are hunger and nest defense, not knowledge of the theft.

encounters.name: Raiders watch
encounters.description: Skarn's lookouts camp in the watch chamber. They know their chief and the strongbox but not how the relic works.

encounters.name: Skarn Ashhand
encounters.description: Skarn Ashhand, self-proclaimed King of the Green Road, guards the stolen Emberseal behind a scrap throne. He is brave when watched, insecure in private, and wrong about the seal granting a crown.

encounters.description: A brass-bound oak case with a sunburst clasp, secured behind Skarn's scrap throne.
encounters.prompt: The stolen Emberseal glows softly inside its protective frame.
encounters.success: You have found the queen's missing ward-stone. Bring it back to Briarwatch.

encounters.description: A small dry chest containing two healing draughts; no key or riddle is required.
encounters.prompt: A pair of healing draughts rests in straw.
encounters.success: Useful supplies for the return journey.

quests.name: The queen's missing ward

quests.completion: Skarn is defeated. The brass-bound strongbox in the vault is now accessible. Recover the Emberseal and return to Queen Elowen.

steps.name: Follow the Green Road
steps.description: Leave the market by the main gate and find the Reed farm. Follow the road east through the field and forest, then north to Ember Hollow.

steps.name: Clear the cave watch
steps.description: Overcome the goblin lookouts guarding the inner cave.

steps.name: Defeat Skarn Ashhand
steps.description: Defeat the self-proclaimed king and secure access to his strongbox.

quests.name: The Emberseal returned
quests.description: Bring the recovered ward-stone back to the queen for the promised reward.
quests.completion: Queen Elowen receives the recovered Emberseal and honors her promise of 300 gold. Briarwatch's wards shine again; your adventure is complete.

steps.name: Recover the Emberseal
steps.description: Take the Emberseal from the brass-bound strongbox in the vault.

steps.name: Return to Queen Elowen
steps.description: Return through the cave, forest, farm and market. Present the recovered Emberseal to Queen Elowen in the throne hall.
